Among caregivers, the overall prevalence of SCD was 12.6% and varied by state

In comparison, the prevalence of SCD among noncaregivers was 10.2% (p<0.001)
Compared with noncaregivers, SCD prevalence among caregivers was higher among persons aged 45–64 years
CDC analyzed SCD among caregivers aged ≥45 years through a cross-sectional analysis of data from 22 states

methods_quotes.q: Weighted, unadjusted prevalence of SCD by caregiver status was estimated among 93,604 community-dwelling respondents aged ≥45 years
T-tests were used to determine statistically significant differences between caregivers and noncaregivers with SCD
modified Rao-Scott chi-square tests were used to estimate statistical differences between proportions of caregivers with and without SCD
Complex survey data methods were used to estimate weighted percentages and corresponding 95% CIs using SAS-callable SUDAAN survey procedures
P-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant for both tests.
The relative standard error for all estimates was <30%.
